name: How do I stop AI-generated webinar slides from becoming crowded and confusing?
description: Keep one main message per slide, use short headlines, and move detailed explanation into speaker notes or a handout. Ask AI to remove jargon and repetitive text

mainEntity.name: How do I stop AI-generated webinar slides from becoming crowded and confusing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use a simple information hierarchy: headline, supporting visual or example, explanation, and action. Avoid filling slides with AI-generated paragraphs; place nuance in speaker notes, handouts, or the follow-up resource. Context: Presentation resources emphasize matching terminology and examples to what attendees already know. Run My AI Biz’s audience includes people who may feel overwhelmed by technical instructions, so plain-language explanations and visible steps are especially useful. Key factors: - Reading distance and screen size - Audience familiarity - Number of ideas per slide - Need for captions or transcripts Practical guidance: Ask AI to shorten headlines, remove jargon, and produce a plain-language version for review. Test the deck on a small screen and read it with a screen reader when possible. Provide a structured transcript or accessible summary after the event.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep one main message per slide, use short headlines, and move detailed explanation into speaker notes or a handout. Ask AI to remove jargon and repetitive text, then test the deck on a small screen and check that captions, transcripts, visuals, and reading order remain understandable.
